name: devprojex
description: Read-only MCP server that turns a local project folder into token-efficient codebase context for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents. Secrets are masked before anything leaves the project, and an agent journal records every call the agent made to DevProjex.
long_description:
DevProjex gives a coding agent eight read-only tools for one project folder: list the project and its policies, view the tree, measure a selection, pack files into context, read stored results, search file contents, trace related files, and read files by path, line range, or symbol.

Secrets are masked before any text reaches the agent, and the tools cannot modify files, run project code, or touch the network.

The server starts with `npx -y devprojex mcp --root <project folder>` and needs Node.js 20 or later. On first start npx downloads the DevProjex build for your operating system and processor: Windows, macOS, or Linux with glibc, on x64 or arm64.

Startup flags such as `--live`, `--hide-private-data`, and `--search-body-chars` are described in the [MCP server documentation](https://github.com/Avazbek22/DevProjex/blob/master/Docs/McpServer.md).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists local projects, profiles, and baseline filters. Use it to choose a root or inspect policy; use get_tree for structure. Returns indexes, protected names and paths, root types, profiles, and Git/exclusion policy. A local project accepts a unique listed name, #index, or absolute path returned by list_projects; remote URLs require opt-in. No parameters.

tools.name: get_tree
tools.description: Returns filtered structure without contents. Use it to find files by name; use analyze instead for size and token metrics, or pack_context for multi-file content. Returns Markdown/text/JSON/XML within 2,000 lines and 50,000 characters. paths selects literal locations; include_patterns selects names or directories in one call, e.g. include_patterns=["src/middleware/{powered-by,body-limit,bearer-auth}/**/*handler*.ts"]. format=markdown|text|json|xml; max_depth=0..1000 counts levels below the project root; git_scope and filters only narrow. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Measures a selection before packaging: protected metrics, estimates, document size, and largest files. Use it to choose pack_context filters or max_tokens; use get_tree for structure and pack_context for content. Returns measured and estimated metrics without file bodies. Key parameters: detail=full|compact|signatures, top_files, git_scope, paths, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, profile, and max_file_bytes. Last detail_by_pattern match wins. max_tokens reports pack_context's greedy admission; rank and focus require it. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

tools.name: pack_context
tools.description: Builds multi-file project context. Use it after get_tree, search_project, or analyze; use get_file for one file. Returns inline untrusted project data, or pack_id plus a preview above 50,000 characters for read_pack. Key parameters: detail, view=tree|content|tree-content, format, rank, focus, max_tokens, git_scope, and detail_by_pattern. detail=full still transforms content. expand_related adds resolved selected neighbours. focus requires rank=importance; max_tokens admits greedily by estimate. Last pattern override wins. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

tools.name: read_pack
tools.description: Reads a stored result page created by pack_context, search_project, or related_files. Use its pack_id; use pack_context instead when no valid stored result exists. Returns untrusted data up to 1,000 lines or 50,000 characters with trusted continuation or range notes. Protection changes invalidate stored content; selection-only changes retain it with a warning. Ranges and columns are inclusive and 1-based.

tools.name: search_project
tools.description: Searches transformed text with a timed .NET regex. It matches file content, never paths; find names with get_tree include_patterns. Use it for symbols or phrases; symbols=true finds declarations, not uses; use related_files for dependency links. Returns grouped numbered matches, merged context, complete|partial status, inspected/retained/written counts, and continuation. Line numbers use returned text; generated redaction replacements never match. Key parameters: pattern, paths, context_lines, ignore_case, max_results=1..200, git_scope, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, and max_file_bytes. The best unique declaration includes up to 1,800 protected body characters within the same cap. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

tools.name: related_files
tools.description: Finds evidenced dependencies and dependents for one to 16 seed files without widening selection. Use it after search_project or get_tree; use search_project for text references or get_file for content. Returns paths, evidence, resolution status, token estimates, language coverage, partial-parse and configuration diagnostics, and scope; results above 50,000 characters use read_pack. Key parameters: path, direction=dependencies|dependents|both, profile, git_scope, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, and max_file_bytes. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Reads selected text after mandatory secret and configured private-data replacement. Use it after get_tree or search_project; use pack_context for broad multi-file context. Use path for one page or requests for up to eight files and sixteen file/range/symbol selections; forms are exclusive. Send one batched call whenever you want more than one file, range, or known symbol: requests=[{"path":"src/a.ts","symbol":"Router.load"}]. Items report ok, partial, not-returned, or unavailable; overlapping ranges share a 1,000-line/50,000-character cap. Coordinates use returned text; start_column continues a page. Project: unique listed name, absolute path returned by list_projects, or #index.

project_root.title: Project folder
project_root.description: The folder the agent reads through DevProjex. The tools are read-only and never change files.
